programmes.d: When long-time married couple Ruth (Diane Keaton) and Alex (Morgan Freeman) decide to move away from New York City, they must contend with eccentric open house guests, their pushy realtor niece, and the health of their beloved family dog.
Lions For Lambs tells the poignant and layered story of several individuals caught up at various ends of the U.S. War on terror.
When a debt puts a young man's life in danger, he turns to putting a hit out on his evil mother in order to collect the insurance.

After Laure pulls of an audacious jewel heist at the 2001 Cannes Film Festival, she decides to turn a new leaf — but it's not long before her past comes back to haunt her. An intense thriller starring Rebecca Romijn and Antonio Banderas.
A man (Andrew Garfield) struggles to get back his family home that they were evicted from by working for the greedy real estate broker (Michael Shannon) who's the source of his frustration.

Things go awry when car salesman Jerry Lundegaard (William H. Macy) hires two thugs to kidnap his wife. Soon, the very pregnant and chipper Police Chief Marge Gunderson (Frances McDormand) takes the case. Is she up for the challenge? You betcha.
